name: church-ppt-generator
description: Orchestrator for Church PowerPoint Generator (FastAPI backend + Vite/React/TS frontend)

scripts.start:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,BROWSER -c blue,green,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend" "npm run open"
